headline: ‘No stuffy vibes … just good books’: Matt Haig to open bookshop in Brighton
context: ‘My belief, as someone who grew up in a town without a bookshop, is that all communities should have one,’ says author of The Midnight Library Matt Haig, the bestselling author of titles including The Midnight Library and Reasons to Stay Alive , is opening a bookshop in Brighton.

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: ‘My belief, as someone who grew up in a town without a bookshop, is that all communities should have one,’ says author of The Midnight Library Matt Haig, the bestselling author of titles including The Midnight Library and Reasons to Stay Alive , is opening a bookshop in Brighton. The writer plans to open the shop, called Golden, by Christmas. It is located in the Seven Dials neighbourhood, a part of the coastal city that doesn’t currently have a bookshop. Continue reading...
